top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 is original, independently confirmed, mature and clinically very large, and no member disputes the science. P001 anchors the citation in the discovery step, the physiology of GLP-1 and identification of its active truncated form, with Drucker and Holst as the secure core and Mojsov on the discovery side; this is the most traceable citation under the discovery criterion. Mojsov's priority against Habener is unresolved in the record, so I rank P002 (Knudsen in place of Mojsov) second as a defensible fallback, clearly above no award.
